---
title: Pitfalls — CLAHE and Color Spaces
---

## CLAHE tile size

Too small (e.g., 2×2) produces noise amplification; too large (e.g., 64×64) yields minimal local effect. Typical: 8×8 or 16×16.

## Over-enhancement artifacts

High clip limits can cause unnatural contrast and amplify sensor noise. Start with `clipLimit=2.0` and adjust conservatively.

## Green channel usage

While the green channel carries the most signal for retinal vasculature, some tasks (e.g., optic disc detection) benefit from using all channels or converting to LAB and using the L channel.
